title: Rupee jumps 23 paise to 92.62 against US dollar in early trade
summary: The rupee appreciated by 23 paise to 92.62 against the US dollar in early trade on Wednesday. This increase was driven by significant foreign-fund inflows and a surge in domestic equity markets. Meanwhile, Brent crude prices fell by 1.30 percent, supporting the local currency's gain. Additionally, foreign institutional investors bought equities worth Rs 5,672.99 crore on a net basis on Monday.
